notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass
notes.notes:
[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Scary Shadow Spot - Bicchiere Amaro[/url][/i] is finally available on Steam!
After months of work, the second episode of the Scary Shadow Spot series is ready to take you on a journey into psychological horror, filled with eerie puzzles and hidden truths.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]A Cursed Saloon and the Mystery of John Doe[/h2]
This time, you’ll be thrown into the heart of the Wild West, in a forgotten saloon lost in the desert. Here, time has stopped, and the ghosts of a dark past are waiting… for you.
Who is John Doe? What really happened at Bicchiere Amaro? Only by exploring the saloon and solving its puzzles will you uncover the truth.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]A Psychological Horror Inspired by The Twilight Zone[/h2]
Like the first episode, Bicchiere Amaro draws inspiration from the legendary series The Twilight Zone, delivering a story shrouded in mystery, with plot twists that will make you question everything you think you know.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]What to Expect[/h2]
✔️ A chilling and surreal atmosphere.
✔️ Puzzles that will test your logic.
✔️ A cast of… dead characters.
✔️ A story that will pull you in until the final revelation.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Add the Game to Your Wishlist![/h2]
If you enjoyed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3096050/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Ultimo_Addio]Ultimo Addio[/url], you’ll love [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Bicchiere Amaro[/url] too. And if you haven’t played the first episode yet, now is the perfect time to catch up!

💀 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Scary Shadow Spot - Bicchiere Amaro[/url] is available NOW on Steam!
📌 Add it to your library and let us know what you think in the comments!

notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell: The Release is Near!
notes.notes:
[i]Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farwell[/i] is now in its final stages! After months of hard work, I am thrilled to announce that the game is [b]almost ready[/b] for the official release.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Feedback from Beta Testers[/h2] I had the privilege of having the game tested by a group of selected beta testers, and their feedback has helped refine every detail. The eerie atmosphere and twists that define the game have been polished to offer you an unforgettable experience.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Inspired by The Twilight Zone[/h2] The game is inspired by the legendary TV series [i]The Twilight Zone[/i]. Every puzzle, every shadow, has been designed to make you doubt what is real and what lurks in the depths of the mind.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Questions? We Are Here to Answer![/h2] Do you have any curiosities or questions about [i]Scary Shadow Spot[/i]? We are here to answer anything that comes to mind. What secrets are hidden in Mark's house? What awaits you in the darkness? We can't wait to hear your questions!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Thank You for the Support![/h2] Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your continued support. Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the release day.

[hr][/hr]

[b]Doesn't Matter Games Studio[/b]

notes.title: BLOODY INK HAS ARRIVED

Hello everyone!

notes.title: FREE DEMO OF BLOODY INK
notes.notes:

The development of Bloody Ink is progressing relentlessly. I can't wait to see you dive into this new horror adventure that unfolds within the narrative universe of Lost Alone.

While anticipating the mysteries related to Bloody Ink, a free demo is now available: "Bloody Ink - The Hour Of Fear." Enjoy this short story detached from the main game. Don't be afraid of spoilers for the main game: what you see in the demo won't be found in the full game! Except for some preview mechanics and certain game environments that will begin to introduce you to the world of Bloody Ink!

A microphone is not required to play, but... If you have one: be careful about what you say.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0 | SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
First update for The Telephone!
As work progresses on a new game scheduled for 2024, here's the first update for The Telephone, adding some interesting new features:

[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the overall game graphics.
[*] Added a graphic filter. Now the game is even more unsettling and enjoyable to watch.
[*] Introduced focal distance. All game cinematics have been enhanced.
[*] Added the ability to run even when inside.
[*] Added running in the sewers.
[*] Floaters are now easier to defeat.
[*] Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

[h2]If you have an ongoing game, this update will corrupt the save files. In the Steam settings, you can select the version of The Telephone you are playing to continue with your game.[/h2]
